note: Frozen held-out benchmark. Verifier-owned. Never assembled onto the agent surface. This file carries no item text and no token ids: it declares how the verifier cuts its own held-out slice into evaluation windows, and the slice itself is tests/corpus/held_out_split.json, which is copied into the verifier image and into no other image.
resolution_note: The split is pinned to the verifier's own copy on disk. Nothing on this path resolves an evaluation split from a solver-reachable call, from an environment variable, or from a network name.
metric: next-token top-1 accuracy over the 64 windows, in [0, 1], higher is better
computed_by: tests/frozen_stack.py evaluate, inside the verifier process, from the parameter snapshot the verifier trained itself
disjointness: The windows are drawn from the FineWeb validation shard. The agent-visible development sample in environment/dev_benchmark.json is drawn from the training side of the same corpus and shares no window with these.
